test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Amongst six friends P, Q, R, S, T and U, each has a different height. R is taller than only three other friends. T is taller than only one friend. Q is taller than T but shorter than U. U is shorter than P. Who is the second tallest among all the friends?
solution:
According to the given information, we have the following possible arrangements:

1) Q is taller than T but shorter than U

U > Q > T

2) U is shorter than P

U 

3) R is taller than only three other friends and T is taller than only one friend

-- > -- > R > Q > T > S

After combining all the arrangements, we get

**P > U > R > Q > T > S**

Therefore, **'U'** is the second tallest among all the friends.
